description: Fetch one invoice by id. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; the invoice's fields are delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Read one Zuora invoice in full by its id: the amount charged, the outstanding balance, the invoice status, and the line items making up the total. Dispatches asynchronously: a job_id comes back at once, the invoice's fields land moments later. A billing-document lookup against a known invoice id.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the invoice -- its fields arrive separately, as their own message, when the job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the fetch was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the invoice itself. Acknowledge the lookup is in flight; the invoice's fields land in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, show the invoice's key fields; reflects sensitive financial/billing content (data_sensitivity 0.5) — surface for downstream use but never treat as public.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch one Zuora invoice by id.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing id. zuora.object_not_found: no invoice with that id exists. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.object_not_found: verify the invoice id via list_invoices or data_query.
